title: Minimal action-level projectable gauge realization template theorem
question: Does there exist an explicit local projectable-ADM-compatible two-scalar action template, fixed before any soft-s evaluation and with no fitted coefficients, whose exact local field-space redundancy realizes the s6fZ null direction and enforces rank-one kinetic, algebraic and source sectors while leaving exactly one physical scalar in the two-field subsystem?

frozen_template.projectable_adm: N=N(t); gamma_ij and N^i are inert under this field-space redundancy
frozen_template.action_class: S = integral dt d3x N sqrt(gamma) [L_ADM(gamma,K,N;t) + F(Phi,X_Phi,t) + J(Phi,t)], where X_Phi=(D_perp Phi)^2/2 and no dependence on the orthogonal field combination is allowed
frozen_template.coefficient_policy: F, J and L_ADM remain arbitrary predeclared functions; no coefficient is selected from the failed soft-s observable

required_exact_checks: delta Phi = 0 under arbitrary local epsilon(x,t)
quadratic scalar kinetic Hessian is proportional to u*u^T and has determinant zero
quadratic algebraic Hessian is proportional to u*u^T
linear source vector is parallel to u
canonical momenta obey the primary null constraint n.p = 0
the local redundancy makes the null constraint first-class within the two-field subsystem
two-field subsystem physical scalar count is exactly one
reduced inverse response is affine in omega^2 and therefore has at most one finite dynamical pole

decision_rule.TEMPLATE_CLASS_PASS_SCOPED: All exact structural checks pass for the frozen template without fitting any coefficient to soft-s.
decision_rule.TEMPLATE_FAIL_SCOPED: At least one exact structural identity fails for the frozen template.
decision_rule.INCOMPLETE_BLOCKED_SCOPED: The parent or frozen target cannot be verified.

scope: Constructive action-template theorem only. A PASS proves non-emptiness of a symmetry-realized projectable two-scalar class; it does not select a unique RTK completion or close the full ADM/gravity constraint system.
